Dave Matthews Band
July 9, 2024
Northwell Health at Jones Beach Theater - Wantagh, NY

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLS (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Front House Left of FOH, DFC, Mics PAS @ 14'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 7.18 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 24/48) > Audacity 3.5.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

03. Don't Drink the Water²
04. Pantala Naga Pampa >
05. Pig
06. Walk Around the Moon
07. Busted Stuff
08. Squirm
09. Spaceman
10. Madman's Eyes (Fake) >
11. Minarets³
12. Grey Street
13. Lying in the Hands of God >
14. American Baby Intro
15. Dave Speak: What's a Light-year?
16. Black and Blue Bird
17. Let's Dance⁴
18. What Would You Say
19. Dave Speak: Jones Beach Memories
20. Digging a Ditch
21. Dancing Nancies >
22. Warehouse⁵ >
23. Ants Marching⁶
24. Encore Break
25. I'll Back You Up >
26. Crush⁷

Set Time: [02:55:19.731]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ Sojourn of Arjuna interpolation
² includes prelude with Schism and Forty Six & 2 interpolations; This Land Is Your Land interpolation
³ Dave scat intro
⁴ David Bowie cover
⁵ stop-time intro; Louie Louie interpolation
⁶ Carter solo intro; Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation
⁷ Stefan solo intro

There was a fairly persistent breeze coming off the ocean which causes some minor wind rumble in the recording.

Huge thanks to the entire DMB organization for supporting live taping.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.

Compiled on 2024/07/16.
